question: If a creature enchanted by Bear Umbra would be destroyed, can I choose not to use umbra armor?

expected.shortAnswer: No: umbra armor's effect is mandatory, so you remove the damage and destroy the Aura instead.
expected.answer: Umbra armor's effect is mandatory. If the enchanted creature would be destroyed, you must remove all damage from it (if it has any) and destroy the Aura that has umbra armor instead.
